concepts.quote: It will not compile: the string has no closing quote, so Java says unclosed string literal.
concepts.why: For a changed line, it names the broken rule (the missing closing quote), says the error is compile-time, and gives the message 'unclosed string literal'.
The answer says nothing about statements, their order, or semicolons.
